FO ran the acceptance script as written in env -i bash: every step matched (125 tests OK; a ui task with no review exits 1; an undisposed finding exits 1; a reviewed task passes; a report naming a fenced or other preview exits 1; brief 848 words; README 5447 of 5447; adr_lint exit 0). Verdicts compared with main over four corpora (this state 69, subspace-web 24, qnow 109, subspace-relay 60 task files): no change except two relay files, an archived task with two real Surfaces: ui lines (a correct hit) and a live ui task in ideation with no design review (the rule working; relay's FO is told at sync). Words FO reads: the ui ideation gate gains one 14-word line; workflow.md unchanged. Replay (Captain ruling D1): the brief names 3 of the 4 known defects; the cycle-1 Refresh button miss is recorded. External rounds: Codex 4 (round 1 three P2, two fixed and one by option A; round 2 one P2, duplicate review lines, fixed by closing the single-valued-line class; round 3 one P2, fenced Preview candidates, first declined then fixed when roborev rated it High; round 4 clean). RoboRev local (799, 806, 808, 830, 831), its High counted as P1 and fixed. Declined, with reasons: Deferred risk, the check does not read limitations (option A, ADR 0022); Deferred risk, one defect named in 2 of 3 runs; Deferred risk, a column-0 review line quoted in prose is refused; Polish, a brief wording and a preview value with a trailing comment. Second reviewer: copilot because the change alters review rules (a design review required at a ui ideation gate). copilot not run: Copilot refused for quota on 2026-10-13 and the Captain has not said the quota is back. Limit: a reviewer's rate of finding defects, operable previews and Codex-hosted workers not verified.
